title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 78
paragraphs: When Cleomenes realized that the Argives were doing whatever the Lacedaemonian herald announced, he passed the word among his men that when the herald proclaimed breakfast they should instead take up their arms and attack the Argives. This was done: while the Argives, acting on the herald's call, were eating their morning meal, the Lacedaemonians fell upon them. Many were killed, and many more took refuge in the sacred grove of Argos. The Lacedaemonians set up a watch and sat around the grove. Then Cleomenes did the following.
